title: Romel等人发表ApoA1与chemokine受体直接结合的研究
originalTitle: Docking and SPR identify candidate interactions between Apolipoprotein A-I and chemokine receptors
summary: Romel团队通过AlphaFold预测结构结合表面等离子共振实验，首次证实Apolipoprotein A-I（ApoA1）可直接与CXCR4、CXCR2、CCR5等5种chemokine受体结合。

story.title: Romel团队首次证实ApoA1与5种chemokine受体直接结合

author: Romel, C., Blanchet, X., Maas, S., van der Vorst, E. P. C.
